description: This file defines traits and case classes for filtering graph elements, flows, and tables within a Spark SQL pipeline project. It includes specific filters for all, none, and selected subsets of flows and tables, as well as composite filters.

classes.name: GraphFilter
classes.description: A sealed trait for filtering graph elements of generic type E.

classes.name: FlowFilter
classes.description: A trait extending GraphFilter specifically for ResolvedFlow elements.

classes.name: TableFilter
classes.description: A trait extending GraphFilter for Table elements, with a nonEmpty method.

classes.name: AllFlows
classes.description: A singleton object representing a filter that includes all flows.

classes.name: FlowsForTables
classes.description: A filter for flows directed to specific tables identified by TableIdentifier.

classes.name: UnionFlowFilter
classes.description: A filter combining two FlowFilters into a union.

classes.name: NoFlows
classes.description: A singleton object representing a filter that excludes all flows.

classes.name: AllTables
classes.description: A singleton object representing a filter that includes all tables.

classes.name: NoTables
classes.description: A singleton object representing a filter that excludes all tables.

classes.name: SomeTables
classes.description: A filter for a specific set of tables identified by TableIdentifier.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters elements based on the filter criteria.

methods.name: filterNot
methods.description: Filters elements that do not match the filter criteria.

methods.name: nonEmpty
methods.description: Indicates whether the filter includes at least one element.
